audit.whatIsWrong: Akali takes six of seven stages here while the headline number is 54.5% to Akali over 1004 games - directionally fine - but the mirror entry nasus__akali.json records the opposite packet defect ('Nasus wins 54.38% but the chart gives Akali 6/7 stages'), so the two sides are reading the same matchup from different win-rate rows.
audit.why: I cannot resolve which row is authoritative from the files I am allowed to read, and guessing a chart flip would be worse than leaving it. Charts untouched on this side so the mirror stays consistent.
audit.corrected: No chart or rating edits; see questionsForUser.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was described as 'a near-free kill on a champ with no escape' and breakdown.spikes listed 'Wither online, level 6, first item' - Fury of the Sands is named nowhere in either layer.
audit.why: Fury of the Sands is Nasus's level-6 spike and it directly answers Akali's: it grants bonus Health, bonus Armor AND Magic Resistance, extra attack range, percent-health damage around him, and a reduced Siphoning Strike cooldown, on 120/100/80s. Telling a player level 6 is free without mentioning the ability that hands him MR is the exact way this all-in gets lost. Twilight Shroud is also not available before level 3, so 'levels 2-3' was wrong.
audit.corrected: tldr, report[0].t, enemyWin, breakdown.spikes, phases[4].why, report[5].t, report[11].t and content whys[4] and spikes[1].text now name Fury of the Sands and its 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wither was described only as 'His only kite. Shroud through it.' with no range, no cooldown and no mention that it ramps.
audit.why: Wither is 15/14/13/12/11s from 700 range and decelerates move and attack speed over time rather than all at once - which is why baiting it and committing after is the play, and why fighting through it gets worse the longer you stand there. Siphoning Strike is also an auto-attack reset at 255 range on 7.5s down to 3.5s, cut further while his R is up.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[1].t, dontsFull[1].d, winCon, report[1].t, report[9].t and phases[1].why rebuilt on the real numbers.

audit.why: Plated Steelcaps and early Grievous Wounds are both right: Siphoning Strike is physical and Soul Eater is flat life steal, so anti-heal is what makes chip stick. Left alone.
